title: Remarks on diagonal dimension for algebraic stacks
summary: This note is concerned with the Rouquier dimension of the bounded derived category of coherent complexes on a Noetherian algebraic stack. Specifically, we study the diagonal dimension of a morphism, which can be used to produce upper bounds on Rouquier dimension. First, we obtain an explicit upper bound for smooth morphisms with a regular target. Second, we identify classical generators of a fibre product, recovering a result of Elagin--Lunts--Schnürer.
